subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft stay as a temporary proof target until live Telegram evidence exists, or should maintainers choose a different landing/closure path for the stacked branch?
rationale: The branch intentionally combines two open PR boundaries and the only live proof attempt skipped both sides, so automation cannot safely decide proof sufficiency or the final merge boundary.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep the draft open for a successful redacted Telegram Desktop proof run, then land the split implementation and harness PRs separately.

options.title: Merge Combined Stack
options.body: Merge this draft only if maintainers intentionally want one combined implementation and proof-harness landing boundary.

options.title: Close After Split Path Suffices
options.body: Close the draft once proof is captured elsewhere or maintainers decide the split PRs no longer need this stacked proof target.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open for a successful redacted Telegram Desktop proof run, then land the split implementation and harness PRs separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision centers on Telegram proof-runner sufficiency and proof-harness flow, where this handle has recent relevant history.
